note: What a server sends to put a unit that belongs to no side on the field.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The name the unit answers to, so later messages can name it.

fields.name: node
fields.note: Which of the sender's runs of names this one is drawn from.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where the unit stands, along one ground axis.

fields.name: atY
fields.note: Where the unit stands, in height.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where the unit stands, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: campAtX
fields.note: Where the camp it belongs to sits, along one ground axis.

fields.name: campAtY
fields.note: Where the camp it belongs to sits, in height.

fields.name: campAtZ
fields.note: Where the camp it belongs to sits, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: facingX
fields.note: Which way it faces, along one ground axis.

fields.name: facingY
fields.note: Which way it faces, in height.

fields.name: facingZ
fields.note: Which way it faces, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: name
fields.note: What this unit is called, so a client can tell one from another. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The name the client loads its art and sound under, written and padded as above.

fields.name: uniqueName
fields.note: A further name the unit answers to, written and padded as above.

fields.name: spawnAnimation
fields.note: The name the client loads what it does on arriving under, written and padded as above.

fields.name: team
fields.note: The side it belongs to, or zero where it belongs to none.

fields.name: damageBonus
fields.note: What is added to the damage it deals.

fields.name: healthBonus
fields.note: What is added to the health it holds.

fields.name: roaming
fields.note: How far it wanders from its camp.

fields.name: camp
fields.note: Which camp it belongs to.

fields.name: effectSide
fields.note: The side that gains what killing it grants.

fields.name: revealEvent
fields.note: What makes the unit known to a side that cannot see it.

fields.name: level
fields.note: The level it starts at.

fields.name: spawnDuration
fields.note: How long its arrival takes, in seconds.

fields.name: spawnAt
fields.note: When it arrives, in seconds.

fields.name: behaviour
fields.note: Which set of doings it follows.

fields.name: script
fields.note: The name the client loads those doings under, written and padded as above.
